findings.detail: Both cited messages share a session/time anchor: six weeks of lessons and amp purchased two weeks ago support four weeks. Structured supported=false contradicts the arithmetic and the judges own final explanation.

Question asks about Valentines Day; cited fragments explicitly describe a February 10 flight. Judge marks supported=true by deferring to reference airline, despite acknowledging the date mismatch. Correct entity string does not establish event-time support.
Message today is anchored to 2023-04-15, question date is 2023-04-18. All answers say 0 days. Judge marks correct=false but supported=true despite this contradiction; success already remains false.

Original gold sessions are 2023-01-19 10:47 (recovered today) and 2023-04-10 20:58 (10th jog today), about 81.42 days / 11.63 weeks apart, while reference is 15 weeks. Answer 10 weeks is also unsupported. Judge additionally misreads the first epoch as February 19. No reference correction or rescoring applied.
Answers enumerate two delivery services; reference and chat evidence include a third. A high session recall or individually true facts do not prove completeness of a count.
Retrieved advice supports utensil organization but does not fulfill the granite/sink preference in the reference. Same answer-bearing session is not proof that all relevant facts were delivered.

decision_use: Automated scores are diagnostic only. Do not promote BGE, chat rerank, or the same-model verifier into production based on this run. Retain exact artifacts; next tests need explicit temporal anchors, question/rubric review and evaluator calibration. Current public subset is now observed regression data.
